notes: VCA331: fix screen freezing (fields unresponsive until Ctrl+Shift+I) after modal/save popups. Removed backdrop-filter blur from the shared modal .overlay (a blurred full-screen layer could leave a stale compositor hit-test region swallowing all clicks until a compositor reset/DevTools cleared it) and set backgroundThrottling:false on the main window. Follows the VCA330 render-loop fix.
